name: @polymarket-bot/ledger
description: Append-only accounting ledger (WP-200, handoff §9.15): balanced per-asset transactions with explicit external-clearing accounts, the six §9.15 scopes, fill allocation with an explicit UNATTRIBUTED scope, and rebuildable balance/position projections. Pure layer-1 logic: no I/O, no clock, no randomness, no connection — persistence is a composition-root binding to the WP-040 accounting schema.
